editorial_choices.mourning_buffer: Original cheerful-event schedule is physically put aside in later household scene and not assigned a new date; no legal number of days, remission, instant end of mourning, lawful marriage authorization or fixed wedding date is invented. 数日 denotes repeated household labour, not completion of any statutory mourning period.
editorial_choices.night_observation_window: Daiyu hears death news later on the same day, after other rooms act. The narrative then passes through that actual ensuing night: Zijuan personally observes two awakenings, one for water and one for frame/pillow comfort. Only the following dawn does she write 夜醒二次, separating previous daytime food/medicine from night entries. Closing after数日 refers back to that explicitly observed first night, not a predicted future count.
